title: The grandmaster in the bathroom (Igors Rausis, 2019)
post: He was 58 and kept getting better at chess... until someone checked the bathroom 🚽📱♟️ #chess #history #story #cheating

voice._name: Callum (ElevenLabs premade), eleven_v3 with audio tags in "say"

phrases.text: He was fifty-eight, and he kept getting better at chess.
phrases.say: [curious] He was fifty-eight... and he kept getting better at chess.

phrases.text: Nobody could explain it. Until someone checked the bathroom.
phrases.say: Nobody could explain it... [whispers] until someone checked the bathroom.

phrases.text: This is Igors Rausis. A grandmaster since 1992.
phrases.say: [serious] This is Igors Rausis. A grandmaster since nineteen ninety-two.

phrases.text: At an age when most players fade, he climbed. From 2500 to 2686.
phrases.say: At an age when most players fade... he climbed. From twenty-five hundred... to twenty-six eighty-six.

phrases.text: The oldest player in the world's top 100.
phrases.say: The oldest player... in the world's top one hundred.

phrases.text: But look at who he was beating.
phrases.say: [mischievously] But look at who he was beating.

phrases.text: Small opens. Opponents hundreds of points weaker. Win after win.
phrases.say: Small opens. Opponents hundreds of points weaker. Win... after win.

phrases.text: FIDE's fair-play team started watching him. Quietly. For months.
phrases.say: [serious] FIDE's fair-play team started watching him. Quietly. For months.

phrases.text: July 2019. Strasbourg, France. In the middle of a game, Rausis gets up and walks to the bathroom.
phrases.say: July twenty nineteen. Strasbourg, France. In the middle of a game... Rausis gets up... and walks to the bathroom.

phrases.text: In the toilet he just used, they find a phone.
phrases.say: [whispers] In the toilet he just used... they find... a phone.

phrases.text: Then a photo goes around the world: a grandmaster on a toilet lid, a chess program on his phone.
phrases.say: Then a photo goes around the world. A grandmaster... on a toilet lid... a chess program on his phone.
His phone? [laughs] An iPhone four. In twenty nineteen.

phrases.text: He signs a statement: the phone is his. "I simply lost my mind yesterday."
phrases.say: [serious] He signs a statement. The phone is his. [sighs] 'I simply lost my mind yesterday.'

phrases.text: FIDE bans him for six years and strips his grandmaster title.
phrases.say: FIDE bans him for six years... and strips his grandmaster title.

phrases.text: But the craziest part came a year later.
phrases.say: [mischievously] But the craziest part... came a year later.

phrases.text: A tiny tournament in Latvia. A new name on the list: Isa Kasimi.
phrases.say: A tiny tournament in Latvia. A new name on the list... Isa Kasimi.

phrases.text: New name. Same face. Half the room knew him.
phrases.say: [laughs] New name. Same face. Half the room knew him.

phrases.text: He left. Later he said: "You can change your name, but you cannot hide your face."
phrases.say: He left. Later he said... 'You can change your name... but you cannot hide your face.'

phrases.text: So, how many years would you ban him? Comment a number.
phrases.say: [curious] So... how many years would you ban him? Comment a number.
